headline: 214 customers paid and waited up to 75 minutes for their order
cause: Razorpay delayed this account's webhooks for 75 minutes

heard.note: 1:24 pm, before any alert of yours

answer.title: This one was Razorpay's, and it is fixed
answer.text: From 1:05 pm to 2:20 pm Razorpay sent your payment webhooks late. Payments were captured normally, but your order service waits for the webhook, so orders sat unconfirmed. Razorpay replayed every webhook. The fix cost you nothing.

compared: Compared with your payments on a normal Monday afternoon
cannot_see: whether customers who waited bought elsewhere

root.cause: A queue that sends this account's webhooks fell behind at Razorpay. Your server did nothing wrong.
root.fix: Razorpay replayed every delayed webhook and added an alert on the queue. Nothing to do on your side.
signals: every late order had its payment captured on time
only webhook deliveries were late, for every method and app

actions.title: Replay 214 webhooks
actions.text: Done by Razorpay. Every order was confirmed by 2:34 pm.

actions.title: Evidence pack to Razorpay
actions.text: Payment IDs, the timeline and the cause, so nobody asks you for them again.

actions.title: Tell 37 customers who wrote in
actions.text: Your order is confirmed. Sorry for the wait.

closing: Razorpay posted the root cause at 1:24 pm, 19 minutes after it began, and replayed every webhook by 2:34 pm. Razorpay's fault, so the fix was free.

rca.title: Root cause: Razorpay is sending your webhooks late
lines: Whose side: Razorpay. Your server is answering normally.
Started: 1:05 pm. Payments are captured normally; orders wait for the webhook.
Fix: Razorpay will replay every delayed webhook. Nothing to do on your side.
rca.signed_off: Signed off by Razorpay support at 1:26 pm

messages.text: All 214 webhooks replayed. Every order is confirmed.
